;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Second Nagorno-Karabakh War]]
**Two [[French people|French]] [[journalist]]s working for the [[mass media in France|newspaper]] ''[[Le Monde]]'' are seriously injured by Azeri shelling, according to an [[Armenian government]] source. Two [[Armenians|Armenian]] journalists are also injured in a separate incident. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-armenia-azerbaijan-journalists-condit/two-french-journalists-hit-by-shelling-in-armenia-in-grave-condition-source-idUSKBN26M5U7?il=0 (Reuters)] [https://www.startribune.com/caucasus-4-journalists-injured-in-nagorno-karabakh-fighting/572597552/?scrlybrkr=bfe36a67 (''Star Tribune'')]
**Former [[President of Kazakhstan]], [[Nursultan Nazarbayev]], expresses concern over the escalation of the situation. He also calls for [[Baku]] and [[Yerevan]] to launch [[negotiation]]s. [https://news.am/eng/news/605363.html (News AM)]
**[[Turkey]] issues a statement dismissing the demands for a [[ceasefire]] from the [[United States]], [[France]], and [[Russia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-54366616 (BBC News)]
**The [[Armenia]]n [[ambassador]] to the [[United States]], [[Varuzhan Nersesyan]], says, "Right now, what is necessary is an intervention of the highest levels, together with other mediators, [[Russia]] and [[France]], to stop the violence." [https://www.newsweek.com/exclusive-armenia-azerbaijan-speak-out-want-us-1535699 (''Newsweek'')]

;Business and economy
*The [[Tokyo Stock Exchange]] halts all trading for the day after it suffered one of the worst technical glitches in its history. It is undecided if it will reopen on Friday. The [[Nikkei 225]] and [[TOPIX]] were also impacted, as they rely on the same system. [https://www.dw.com/en/tokyo-stock-exchange-trading-stops/a-55113825 (DW)]
*The [[Supreme Court of Ireland]] rules that the bread used by American restaurant [[Franchising|franchise]] [[Subway (restaurant)|Subway]] cannot be classified as bread, due to its high sugar content. The franchise henceforth will be required to pay a 13.5% [[value-added tax]] for their bread instead of being exempted as before. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-54370056 (BBC News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Beirut explosion]]
**The [[government of Lebanon|state]]-run ''National News Agency'' says that [[Lebanon]]'s state prosecution has asked [[Interpol]] to detain two Russian citizens, the captain and owner of the [[MV Rhosus|MV ''Rhosus'']], a ship that carried thousands of tons of [[ammonium nitrate]] to [[Beirut]] in 2013. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2020-10-01/lebanon-asks-interpol-to-arrest-russian-ship-captain-owner-over-port-explosion (Reuters via ''U.S. News'')]
*Eight people are killed and ten others are injured as a series of [[wildfire]]s sweeps through part of eastern [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/video/watch/at-least-8-killed-in-ukraine-forest-fire-id719984405?chan=8gwsyvzx (Reuters)]
*[[Britons|British]] businessman and TV show host [[Zef Eisenberg]] is killed in a crash while attempting a new land speed record at [[RAF Elvington]] in [[Yorkshire]], [[England]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/10/02/motorsport/zef-eisenberg-dies-gbr-intl-scli-spt/index.html (CNN)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Community of Madrid]]
*****The [[Government of Spain|Spanish government]] orders a partial [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] in [[Madrid]] and surrounding areas badly affected by [[COVID-19]] after a rise in cases. Under the new restrictions, residents will not be allowed to leave the area unless they have to make an essential journey. However, Madrid's regional government says that the lockdown is not legally valid. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-54364015 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reports 2,548 new cases in the past 24 hours, partly due to higher swab tests that were conducted. It is the biggest daily jump of cases in five months and the first time the country has reported more than 2,000 cases since April. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/italy-reports-biggest-jump-in-virus-cases-in-5-months/1992535 (Anadolu Agency)]
****The [[Prime Minister of Italy|Italian Prime Minister]] [[Giuseppe Conte]] said he would ask [[Parliament of Italy|parliament]] to extend the country's state of emergency to the end of January 2021, as the government tries to avoid the surge in cases seen in other European countries. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-italy-emergency-idUSKBN26M4ME (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
***[[Malaysia]] reports 260 new cases, the second biggest daily spike since the [[pandemic]] began. The sharp increase in infections comes after a surge in travel to and from [[Sabah]] for the [[2020 Sabah state election|state elections]]. The national tally now stands at 11,484 cases with a total of 136 [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|deaths]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/covid-19-malaysia-sabah-second-largest-daily-spike-260-new-cases-13170180 (CNA)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington (state)]], [[2020 Washington wildfires]]
****A family of seven people who lost their homes during the [[2020 Washington Labor Day fires|Labor Day fires]] in the [[Washington (state)|state]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.fox13news.com/news/washington-family-loses-home-in-wildfire-then-all-test-positive-for-covid-19 (Fox13news)] [https://www.cnn.com/2020/10/01/us/coronavirus-family-lost-home-trnd/index.html (CNN)]
***[[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] confirms that top aide [[Hope Hicks]] has tested positive for coronavirus and says he and [[First Lady of the United States|First Lady]] [[Melania Trump]] will begin their "quarantine process" while waiting for their own test results. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/10/01/politics/hope-hicks-positive-coronavirus/index.html (CNN)]

;International relations
*[[Post-Brexit United Kingdom relations with the European Union]]
**After the United Kingdom ignored their demands made in early September to scrap the [[United Kingdom Internal Market Bill|Internal Market Bill]] by the end of the month, the [[European Commission]] sends a letter to the [[government of the United Kingdom]] informing them of its intent to pursue [[International legal system|international legal action]] over the bill, which the [[European Union]] claims violates [[international law]] by overriding article four of the [[Brexit withdrawal agreement]]. [https://asiatimes.com/2020/10/eu-launches-legal-action-over-uk-brexit-bill/ (AFP via ''Asia Times'')]

;Law and crime
*[[2017 Las Vegas shooting]]
**Amidst the third anniversary of the [[mass shooting]] in [[Las Vegas]], Nevada, the [[Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department]] backtracks on an earlier decision and has included, in the official death toll, two women who died from gunshot wound complications over the past year, thereby increasing it from 58 to 60. [https://apnews.com/article/virus-outbreak-las-vegas-las-vegas-mass-shooting-nevada-shootings-ea1ab5537d62f9e3e52bb4f770910452 (AP)] [https://www.reviewjournal.com/local/local-las-vegas/sisolak-we-will-never-never-forget-those-killed-in-oct-1-shooting-2134042/ (''The Las-Vegas Review Journal'')]
*[[Belgium]]'s [[Court of appeal (Belgium)|court of appeal]] recognizes the [[genealogical DNA test]] result of [[Delphine Boël]] as the daughter of King [[Albert II of Belgium|Albert II]], thereby instating her to the title of Princess of Belgium with the predicate "Her Royal Highness". Having been recognized as the [[Royal bastard|illegitimate daughter]] of Albert, Boël was given the honorific [[Jonkheer|Jonkvrouw]], the lowest rank within the [[Belgian nobility|Belgian titled nobility]], prior to the decision. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/belgian-kings-hidden-daughter-wins-fight-to-be-princess (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')] 

;Politics and elections
*[[Alessandro Cardelli]] and [[Mirko Dolcini]] are sworn in [[Captains Regent]] of [[San Marino]]. Cardelli becomes the world's youngest head of state. [https://www.sanmarinortv.sm/news/attualita-c4/alessandro-cardelli-e-mirko-dolcini-sono-i-nuovi-capitani-reggenti-a194943 (San Marino RTV)]
;Science and technology
*[[Life on Venus]]
**According to a study from researchers at the [[University of California, Riverside]], [[Venus]] would be able to support life if [[Jupiter]] hadn't [[Nice model|altered its orbit]] around the [[Sun]] nearly 4 billion years ago. [https://phys.org/news/2020-09-venus-habitable-today-jupiter.html (Phys.org)] [https://www.cnn.com/2020/10/01/world/venus-habitable-jupiter-scli-intl-scn/index.html (CNN)]
